fields.climate: tropical; moderated by easterly trade winds (March to November); westerly gales and heavy rain (November to March)
fields.hazards: severe tropical storms are usually rare, but in 1997 there were three cyclones; low levels of islands make them sensitive to changes in sea level
fields.farm: coconuts, vegetables, tropical fruits, bananas, root vegetables, pork, chicken, eggs, pork fat, pork offal
fields.languages: Tuvaluan (official), English (official), Samoan, Kiribati (on the island of Nui)
fields.religions: Protestant 92.7% (Congregational Christian Church of Tuvalu 85.9%, Brethren 2.8%, Seventh Day Adventist 2.5%, Assemblies of God 1.5%), Baha'i 1.5%, Jehovah's Witness 1.5%, other 3.9%, none or refused…

system.text: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm

fields.legal: mixed system of English common law and local customary law
